comment_0: Fields marked as comments are FYI only - they will not be used in the game.
comment_1: You can add other text fields here too. Like your name, version, date, etc. They will not be used in the mod but serve as your creation identification here.
comment_2: The isTranslation field is mandatory to identify this file as a translation.
comment_3: The translatedFileName field is mandatory to identify the base character plugin file, which should reside in the same folder as this file.
comment_4: If the base file does not exist or is located in a different folder, the data in this translation file will be ignored.
comment_5: This table should contain at least one performers group entry: femalePerformers and/or malePerformers. If missing or empty, it will be ignored.

femalePerformers.comment_0: This table should contain your performers metadata entries. If empty, it will be ignored.
femalePerformers.comment_1: It could contain a single performer, or multiple performers - it's all up to you.
femalePerformers.comment_2: The performer entry key names should match the entry key names in the base character plugin file. If there is no match, they will be ignored.

performer_female_01.comment_0: The performerFullNameTranslations table should contain your translations.
performer_female_01.comment_1: While it is possible to include multiple languages, it is recommended to limit each translation file to a single language.
performer_female_01.comment_2: If some characters in the base plugin file do not require translation, you can simply skip them.
performer_female_01.comment_3: If the performerFullNameTranslations table or its entries are missing, empty, or invalid, they will be ignored, and the mod will use the base plugin data instead.
performer_female_01.comment_4: Please keep in mind that cetUi strings are used in the CET interface which is limited on displayed character sets.

de-de.cetUi: German translation of the performer name for display in the CET UI
de-de.nativeUi: German translation of the performer name for display in the Native UI

malePerformers.comment_0: If needed, just follow the femalePerformers table structure here
